title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Sales Standard: Pricing and Issuing a New Pass
content:
**Standard.** A Tailwise Grooming Salon pass is priced from the pass price for the pet's size class on the purchase date, which is recorded on the pass as its size class at purchase, less the single household discount, rounded half up to the cent. The pass credits the number of visits included in that pass, and its expiry date is the purchase date plus the pass's validity in calendar months, falling back to the last day of the month. Groom Club Monthly charges its first monthly fee at purchase, credits one month's visits and sets the next billing date one month after purchase. The pet's species must be in the pass's species list and the pet must be at least the pass's youngest age, in weeks, on the purchase date.

The pass prices, visits, validity, species lists and youngest ages are those of the salon rate card.

**What is fixed at purchase**

| Item | How it is set |
|---|---|
| Price paid | rate-card price for the pet's size class on the purchase date, less the one household discount applied, rounded half up to the cent |
| Size class at purchase | the pet's size class on the purchase date |
| Visits credited | the pass's included visits (Groom Club Monthly: one month's visits) |
| Expiry date | purchase date plus the validity in calendar months; where that month has no such day, the last day of the month |
| Next billing date (Groom Club Monthly only) | one month after purchase; the first monthly fee is charged at purchase |

**Who may be sold the pass**

- The pet's species is in the pass's species list, and
- the pet is at least the pass's youngest age in weeks on the purchase date.

**Worked examples (hypothetical purchases)**

- A medium dog, Full Groom Pass 6-Visit, rate-card price 428.40, multi-pet discount of 10 percent applied: 428.40 less 10 percent is 385.56. Six visits are credited.
- A Full Groom Pass 4-Visit bought on 31 August with a 12-month validity expires on 31 August of the following year; a 6-month Express Bath Pass 3-Visit bought on 31 August expires on the last day of February, there being no 31 February.
- A small dog, Full Groom Pass 4-Visit at 252.00 with a 5 percent wellness-plan discount: 252.00 less 5 percent is 239.40.
